scope: CP8 staged Java-only raster glyph workflow: technique mechanism, actual edit/retention/save behavior, explicit font. Packaging not yet delivered; not source-pixel or full-corpus certification.

baseline.observation: Upright digits accumulate into soft gray curved ribbons. Several terminal digits remain recognizable; heavy overlap obscures many interiors. Some paths clip the left or lower canvas edge.

short.observation: Shorter curved fragments leave more open ground and show fewer long joins. The ramp is rescaled over the visible prefix, so this is not simply a raster crop of baseline.

sparse.observation: Same broad trajectories with lighter, individually discernible repeated outlines and reduced overlap. Most neighboring glyphs still overlap; this is not disjoint character layout.

letters.observation: Angular and open letter shapes change ribbon edges and terminal silhouettes while retaining the same path arrangement.

dots.observation: Narrow smooth gray curves expose the underlying trajectories, retaining the same major bends and clusters.

colour.observation: Teal, warm red and yellow progress along the same digit trails; the geometry remains fixed while overlap changes the perceived band tones.

distance.observation: Longer sweeping curves extend across and outside the canvas, connecting larger areas. This is changed integration geometry, unlike sparse sampling of the original trajectory.

field-scale.observation: More frequent short bends and waviness replace broad smooth arcs, clearly changing path shape.

new-seed.observation: Different starting positions and marks produce a different arrangement of curved ribbons and clusters.

limitations: No human artist usability session; controls exercised programmatically.
Sparse stamps still overlap; no isolated-character or legibility guarantee.
Some trails cross canvas bounds; no text-aware collision or clipping layout.
Different font, noise, RNG, canvas and renderer from motivating numbers source.
No glyph outlines, paragraph layout, kerning, shaping, other-font or other-target validation.
Image difference metrics compare CP8 edit states with CP8 baseline only; no survey-reference metric claim.
